turns.en: Call it 10% of your cash or whatever. So you can actually have a little bit of both best of both worlds, right? Right. I mean, you can do cash management, especially like if you're in the Atlas portfolio, where the max position is not 150%, it's 300%.
turns.zh: 就叫它你现金的 10% 或者随便多少。所以你其实可以有一点两全其美，对吧？对。我是说，你可以做现金管理，尤其是如果你在 Atlas 组合里，那儿最大仓位不是 150%，是 300%。

turns.en: So when you're talking about things like that, yes, you can use the extra cash to own t-bills to your notes 10 years. You pick your flavor of how you want to manage your cash.
turns.zh: 所以当你谈那类事情时，是的，你可以用那些多余的现金去持有国库券（t-bills）、你的 10 年期票据。你挑你自己想要的那种方式来管理你的现金。

turns.en: But yes, you can actually end up leveraging one thing so that you can end up making money somewhere else. Love it. What's next? When are all these daughters done with college?
turns.zh: 但是的，你其实可以通过给一样东西加杠杆，从而在别的地方赚到钱。喜欢。接下来呢？你这些女儿什么时候大学毕业？

turns.en: My oldest- What are they going to do, work for you? This is kind of a fun story. My oldest son, I graduated from University of Alabama five years ago.
turns.zh: 我最大的——他们要干什么，给你干活吗？这算是个有趣的故事。我最大的儿子，五年前从 University of Alabama 毕业。

turns.en: He has a double masters. He has an MBA and a master's in mechanical engineering. He went to work for General Motors in Detroit. And he was not very happy.
turns.zh: 他有双硕士。他有一个 MBA 和一个机械工程硕士。他去 Detroit 的 General Motors 工作。而他并不太开心。

turns.en: The corporate structure wasn't advantageous to him. So ironically, yes, ironically, the head research job at NSVC Trading Group came open and he now works alongside me, not for me, but in the same business.
turns.zh: 公司的架构对他不利。所以讽刺的是，是的，讽刺的是，NSVC Trading Group 的首席研究岗位空出来了，他现在跟我一起共事，不是给我干，而是在同一个行业里。

turns.en: I talk to him on a daily basis and get to see him a lot, which is, he lives in Nashville and I live in Memphis. So I mean, I get to see him a lot, which is beautiful.
turns.zh: 我每天跟他聊，也能经常见到他，这是，他住在 Nashville，我住在 Memphis。所以我是说，我能经常见到他，这很美好。

turns.en: And my middle daughter, she graduated from University of Alabama a year ago, year and change, and she's in commercial insurance and is very happy.
turns.zh: 然后我中间的女儿，她一年前从 University of Alabama 毕业，一年多，她做商业保险，很开心。

turns.en: And then my baby boy, he's, like I say, baby, gosh, he's 20 and he's six, three, which, you know, with me at five, six, that's quite a big difference.
turns.zh: 然后我的小儿子，他，就像我说的，宝贝，天哪，他 20 岁，身高六英尺三，你知道，跟我五英尺六比，那是相当大的差距。

turns.en: But no, he's- I'd call that one off, yeah. Yeah, I'm still trying to figure that out. Now there's height on both sides of our families. So I just got the shorting of the stick, no pun intended.
turns.zh: 但不，他——这个我认输了，yeah。是啊，我还在琢磨那件事。现在我们两家都有高个子。所以我只是拿到了那根短签（short end of the stick），没有双关的意思。

turns.en: But yeah, so, yeah, he's a sophomore and I doubt it all mess. So I got another two and a half, three daughters, two sons, one daughter. Two sons, one daughter.
turns.zh: 但 yeah，所以，yeah，他是大二，我怀疑是不是 Ole Miss。所以我还有另外两年半、三年，三个女儿，两个儿子，一个女儿。两个儿子，一个女儿。

turns.en: All right, I'm going to finish it out. Your favorite, give me three of your favorite movies that have to do with Memphis. Or I could give you the list if you want.
turns.zh: 好，我来收尾。你最喜欢的，给我三部你最喜欢的、跟 Memphis 有关的电影。或者如果你愿意，我可以给你那份清单。

turns.en: I came up with a list. But what do you got off the top of your head? There's one obvious answer, right? Well, so not really about Memphis, but Memphis Bell.
turns.zh: 我列了一份清单。但你脱口而出有什么？有一个显而易见的答案，对吧？嗯，所以不真的是关于 Memphis，但 Memphis Belle（《孟菲斯美女号》）。

turns.en: I really enjoyed that movie a lot. Memphis, obviously, you know, oh, it's really good. World War II movie. And the plane was called the Memphis Bell.
turns.zh: 我非常喜欢那部电影。Memphis，显然，你知道，哦，它真的很好。二战电影。而那架飞机就叫 Memphis Belle。

turns.en: Got it, yeah, yeah, yeah. Obviously, you have to say the new Elvis biopic, you know, I was too young to really remember Elvis and his heyday.
turns.zh: 明白了，yeah，yeah，yeah。显然，你得说那部新的 Elvis 传记片，你知道，我太小了，真的记不清 Elvis 和他的鼎盛时期。

turns.en: And then the other one was The Firm. The Firm, yeah, that was my obvious one. That was on the other night and I got sucked in. I'm like, that's so good.
turns.zh: 然后另一部是 The Firm（《糖衣陷阱》）。The Firm，yeah，那是我那个显而易见的答案。那部前几天晚上在放，我被吸进去了。我想，那太好看了。

turns.en: Okay, so what's your list? The Firm, but then all those. I think Rainmaker and the other Grisham one, I can't remember were in there, right?
turns.zh: 好，那么你的清单是什么？The Firm，然后所有那些。我想 Rainmaker（《造雨人》）和另一部 Grisham 的，我记不清了，也在里面，对吧？

turns.en: Yes, all in and around Memphis. Blind, blind, blind, blind, blind, blind, blind, blind. Blindside. Oh, yeah, that was a good one. And then Castaway, a little weird, but he's based at FedEx in Memphis, right?
turns.zh: 是的，全都在 Memphis 里里外外。Blind，blind，blind，blind，blind，blind，blind，blind。Blindside（《弱点》）。哦，yeah，那是部好片子。然后 Castaway（《荒岛余生》），有点奇怪，但他以 Memphis 的 FedEx 为基地，对吧？

turns.en: Correct, correct. Yes, FedEx was founded in Memphis, but. And Walk the Line, that Memphis-y? That's more Nashville. Nashville, all right. Yeah, Johnny Cash, that's more Nashville.
turns.zh: 对，对。是的，FedEx 是在 Memphis 创立的，但。还有 Walk the Line（《一往无前》），那算 Memphis 吗？那更多是 Nashville。Nashville，好吧。是啊，Johnny Cash，那更多是 Nashville。
